title: File not recognised
fix: Open a readme.txt (starts with === Plugin Name ===) or the main plugin PHP file (header comment with Plugin Name:).

title: readme.txt does not start with === Plugin Name ===
fix: Make the first non-empty line === Your Plugin Name ===

title: No Stable tag line
fix: Stable tag: 1.0.0

title: Stable tag: trunk ships trunk to every install
fix: Stable tag: <the version you tagged>

title: No Requires at least line
fix: Requires at least: 6.5

title: No Requires PHP line
fix: Requires PHP: 7.4

title: No Tested up to line
fix: Tested up to: 6.8

title: Tested up to carries a patch number
fix: Tested up to: <major.minor only>

title: Tested up to is older than Requires at least
fix: Raise Tested up to, or lower Requires at least

title: Short description is over 150 characters
fix: Cut the line under the header block to 150 characters

title: More than five tags; only the first five are used
fix: Keep five tags, the five you want to rank for

title: License or License URI missing
fix: License: GPLv2 or later + License URI: https://www.gnu.org/licenses/gpl-2.0.html

title: No == Changelog == section
fix: Add == Changelog == with an entry for this version

title: Plugin header has no Version
fix: Version: 1.0.0 in the header comment

title: Plugin header has no Requires PHP
fix: Requires PHP: 7.4 in the header comment

title: Plugin header has no License line
fix: License: GPLv2 or later in the header comment

title: Plugin header has no Text Domain
fix: Text Domain: <your plugin slug>

title: No direct-access guard
fix: defined( 'ABSPATH' ) || exit; under the header

title: Script or style enqueued from a remote URL
fix: Ship the file inside the plugin and enqueue it with plugins_url()

title: eval, base64_decode or gzinflate in plugin code
fix: Ship readable PHP; the review team reads every line

title: Hard-coded wp-content/plugins path
fix: plugin_dir_path() instead of the literal path
